# Video script: tutorial 12, Further tips

**Goal:** Find and change many items at once, control what your players see, and trace a map of your own from an existing image.

**Opening narration:** In this last video: finding and changing many places at once, keeping secrets from your players, and tracing a map from an existing image.

## 1. Search the lists

**Narration:** Open Routes and pins. The pins list is long, so search it: type ford, and only the matching places are left.

**On screen:**

- Click Routes and pins on the rail.
- Set Search by name to ford.

**Camera:** the panel

**Hold:** 3 s after the action

**Matches the wiki's image:** `12-further-tips-search.png`

## 2. Filter the lists

**Narration:** Clear the search, and filter instead: generated pins of the kind Ruined town.

**On screen:**

- Set Search by name to .
- Set Made by to Generated.
- Set Kind of pin to Ruined town.

**Camera:** the whole studio

**Hold:** 2 s after the action

## 3. Change them all at once

**Narration:** Select items for mass edit, select all, and open Mass edit. Set the visibility to GM only.

**On screen:**

- Click Select items for mass edit.
- Click Select all.
- Click Mass edit.
- The dialogue opens.
- Set Visibility to GM only.

**Camera:** the dialog

**Hold:** 2 s after the action

**Matches the wiki's image:** `12-further-tips-mass-edit.png`

## 4. Confirm

**Narration:** Confirm, and all thirteen change at once.

**On screen:**

- Click Confirm in the dialogue.

**Camera:** the whole studio

**Hold:** 2 s after the action

## 5. Visibility and the views

**Narration:** Everything on the map is visible to everyone, to the GM only, or hidden. The first three buttons of the map controls choose which you see. Here, with the GM view on, the ruins show.

**On screen:**

- Zoom in on the west of the Red Hills.

**Camera:** the map from 300, 420 to 760, 780

**Hold:** 3 s after the action

**Matches the wiki's image:** `12-further-tips-gm-view.png`

## 6. See what your players see

**Narration:** Turn off GM view, and the ruins disappear: this is your players' map, and what an export shows.

**On screen:**

- Click GM view.

**Camera:** the map from 300, 420 to 760, 780

**Hold:** 4 s after the action

**Matches the wiki's image:** `12-further-tips-player-view.png`

## 7. Hide something

**Narration:** Turn GM view back on, and hide Redwatch from everyone. The Hidden button shows hidden things while you work, but they're never exported.

**On screen:**

- Click GM view.
- Set Kind of pin to All kinds.
- Set Made by to Any origin.
- Set Search by name to Redwatch.
- Click Redwatch.
- Set Visibility to Hidden.
- Click Hidden.

**Camera:** the whole studio

**Hold:** 4 s after the action

**Matches the wiki's image:** `12-further-tips-hidden.png`

## 8. Save the regional map

**Narration:** Turn the Hidden view off, and save.

**On screen:**

- Click Hidden.
- Click Close on the inspector.
- Click Save map.

**Camera:** the whole studio

**Hold:** 2 s after the action

## 9. Start a map to trace

**Narration:** Now a new map, the same size as the sketch we'll trace. Create it, and delete the land masks it kept, so it starts as open sea.

**On screen:**

- Click New map on the rail.
- Set the map's width to 1200.
- Set the map's height to 900.
- Click Create new map.
- Wait for the map to update.
- Click Delete all land masks.
- Click Yes in the dialogue.

**Camera:** the whole studio

**Hold:** 2 s after the action

## 10. Show the sketch

**Narration:** Open the Reference image tool and choose the sketch. It lies over the map as a guide.

**On screen:**

- Click Reference image on the rail.
- Click Choose a file and choose ashgrove-sketch.png.
- Reset view.

**Camera:** the whole studio

**Hold:** 3 s after the action

**Matches the wiki's image:** `12-further-tips-reference.png`

## 11. Trace it

**Narration:** Back in New map, click round the island's coast and the isle, and draw the lake as ocean. The engine fills in the land.

**On screen:**

- Click New map on the rail.
- Choose Land on the bar.
- Click round the outline of the island (14 points), then right-click to finish it.
- Choose Land on the bar.
- Click round the outline of the isle (5 points), then right-click to finish it.
- Choose Ocean on the bar.
- Click round the outline of the lake (5 points), then right-click to finish it.
- Wait for the map to update.

**Camera:** the whole studio

**Hold:** 4 s after the action

**Matches the wiki's image:** `12-further-tips-traced.png`

## 12. Carry on

**Narration:** Stop drawing, hide the reference image, and save. From here, everything in this tutorial applies to your own map.

**On screen:**

- Click Stop drawing.
- Click Close on the inspector.
- Click Reference image in the map controls.
- Reset view.
- Click Save map.
- Type "The Isle of Ashgrove" in the dialogue and click Confirm.

**Camera:** the map from 0, 0 to 1200, 900

**Hold:** 4 s after the action

**Matches the wiki's image:** `12-further-tips-ashgrove.png`

---

12 steps; at least 35 s of holds, plus the actions themselves.
